entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-04-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Improve behavior for FBA when globaljson locked to non-existent version #83304
  • Idea: Investigate if interpolated string handler for incremental generators can improve perf #83296
  • [Known Build Error] SemanticSearch.ReferenceAssemblies: Error updating baseline because it is being used by another process #83289

  • Roslyn formatter silently corrupts tab/space indentation despite all formatting options disabled #83285
